For more content use returned next_offset and next_column as offset and column. The 'N| ' line prefixes are display only: never copy them into edit_file or write_file content. PDF pages accepts '2' or '2-5'. Document extraction is text-only; images have metadata only, no OCR/visual understanding. Relative paths start at /tmp/tiny-agent-bench-lvkx_vxk/workspace; absolute and ~ paths are supported. Paths must remain inside this workspace. Each result is capped at 16000 characters; use the continuation cursor.

column.description: Character cursor for continuing a clipped line; default 0.

pages.description: PDF page or inclusive range, at most 20 pages.

encoding.description: Text encoding, default utf-8; e.g. utf-16 or latin-1.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or replace a local text file, creating parent directories. Set append=true to append. Use edit_file for targeted changes. Optionally pass expected_version from read_file. Unchanged content is left untouched; existing file permissions are preserved. Content that is not valid JSON is refused for .json files; a .py file that does not parse is written and reported under diagnostics. Relative paths start at /tmp/tiny-agent-bench-lvkx_vxk/workspace; absolute and ~ paths are supported. Paths must remain inside this workspace.

Does not recurse through symlinks. Use next_offset to continue a truncated listing. Relative paths start at /tmp/tiny-agent-bench-lvkx_vxk/workspace; absolute and ~ paths are supported. Paths must remain inside this workspace.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read local text/code, PDF or Office documents. Returns line-numbered content and a version. offset is a 1-based LINE number, limit is lines (default 2000). For more content use returned next_offset and next_column as offset and column. The 'N| ' line prefixes are display only: never copy them into edit_file or write_file content. PDF pages accepts '2' or '2-5'. Document extraction is text-only; images have metadata only, no OCR/visual understanding. Relative paths start at /tmp/tiny-agent-bench-lvkx_vxk/workspace; absolute and ~ paths are supported. Paths must remain inside this workspace. Each result is capped at 16000 characters; use the continuation cursor.

column.description: Character cursor for continuing a clipped line; default 0.

pages.description: PDF page or inclusive range, at most 20 pages.

encoding.description: Text encoding, default utf-8; e.g. utf-16 or latin-1.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or replace a local text file, creating parent directories. Set append=true to append. Use edit_file for targeted changes. Optionally pass expected_version from read_file. Unchanged content is left untouched; existing file permissions are preserved. Content that is not valid JSON is refused for .json files; a .py file that does not parse is written and reported under diagnostics. Relative paths start at /tmp/tiny-agent-bench-lvkx_vxk/workspace; absolute and ~ paths are supported. Paths must remain inside this workspace.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List local directory entries with names, types and file sizes. recursive=true explores subdirectories. Common build/cache directories are omitted unless include_ignored=true. Does not recurse through symlinks. Use next_offset to continue a truncated listing. Relative paths start at /tmp/tiny-agent-bench-s3_qdrbt/workspace; absolute and ~ paths are supported. Paths must remain inside this workspace.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read local text/code, PDF or Office documents. Returns line-numbered content and a version. offset is a 1-based LINE number, limit is lines (default 2000). For more content use returned next_offset and next_column as offset and column. The 'N| ' line prefixes are display only: never copy them into edit_file or write_file content. PDF pages accepts '2' or '2-5'. Document extraction is text-only; images have metadata only, no OCR/visual understanding. Relative paths start at /tmp/tiny-agent-bench-s3_qdrbt/workspace; absolute and ~ paths are supported. Paths must remain inside this workspace. Each result is capped at 16000 characters; use the continuation cursor.

column.description: Character cursor for continuing a clipped line; default 0.

pages.description: PDF page or inclusive range, at most 20 pages.

encoding.description: Text encoding, default utf-8; e.g. utf-16 or latin-1.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or replace a local text file, creating parent directories. Set append=true to append. Use edit_file for targeted changes. Optionally pass expected_version from read_file. Unchanged content is left untouched; existing file permissions are preserved. Content that is not valid JSON is refused for .json files; a .py file that does not parse is written and reported under diagnostics. Relative paths start at /tmp/tiny-agent-bench-s3_qdrbt/workspace; absolute and ~ paths are supported. Paths must remain inside this workspace.
